source.locator: lines 62-64, second formula defining the strict-order relation

findings.finding: The second existential formula ends with the unmarked variable v_2 even though every object-language variable in the formula and the parallel first formula carries the \Obj marker.
findings.controlling_evidence: Both formulas are stated to express the same strict-order relation in the arithmetic language. The immediately preceding formula uses \Obj v_2, and the chapter's object-language notation consistently marks these variables with \Obj.
findings.required_translation_handling: Restore only the missing \Obj marker before v_2, preserve the formula otherwise, and add an adjacent OLTEFOLMAT-001 disclosure.
